verdict.rationale: Vapi documents dynamic variables injected into the system prompt or any message with double-curly-brace syntax (vapi-docs-41). It also has a dedicated Personalization feature for adding customer-specific information to conversations (vapi-docs-42), and supports transient inline configurations that can be supplied per call (vapi-docs-47). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how variable values are passed at call start via the API, details on fetching per-caller context dynamically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
